title: "Budget and Revenue"

```{python}
#| echo: true

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
```

## Budget and revenue

@fig-budget-revenue shows the relationship between film budgets and worldwide revenue. Each point represents one film in the dataset.

```{python}
#| label: fig-budget-revenue
#| fig-cap: "Film budget against worldwide revenue"
#| echo: true

plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Budget (millions of US dollars)")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide revenue (millions of US dollars)")
plt.show()
```
